#====================================================================================================
# START - Testing Protocol - DO NOT EDIT OR REMOVE THIS SECTION
#====================================================================================================

# THIS SECTION CONTAINS CRITICAL TESTING INSTRUCTIONS FOR BOTH AGENTS
# BOTH MAIN_AGENT AND TESTING_AGENT MUST PRESERVE THIS ENTIRE BLOCK

# Communication Protocol:
# If the `testing_agent` is available, main agent should delegate all testing tasks to it.
#
# You have access to a file called `test_result.md`. This file contains the complete testing state
# and history, and is the primary means of communication between main and the testing agent.
#
# Main and testing agents must follow this exact format to maintain testing data. 
# The testing data must be entered in yaml format Below is the data structure:
# 
## user_problem_statement: {problem_statement}
## backend:
##   - task: "Task name"
##     implemented: true
##     working: true  # or false or "NA"
##     file: "file_path.py"
##     stuck_count: 0
##     priority: "high"  # or "medium" or "low"
##     needs_retesting: false
##     status_history:
##         -working: true  # or false or "NA"
##         -agent: "main"  # or "testing" or "user"
##         -comment: "Detailed comment about status"
##
## frontend:
##   - task: "Task name"
##     implemented: true
##     working: true  # or false or "NA"
##     file: "file_path.js"
##     stuck_count: 0
##     priority: "high"  # or "medium" or "low"
##     needs_retesting: false
##     status_history:
##         -working: true  # or false or "NA"
##         -agent: "main"  # or "testing" or "user"
##         -comment: "Detailed comment about status"
##
## metadata:
##   created_by: "main_agent"
##   version: "1.0"
##   test_sequence: 0
##   run_ui: false
##
## test_plan:
##   current_focus:
##     - "Task name 1"
##     - "Task name 2"
##   stuck_tasks:
##     - "Task name with persistent issues"
##   test_all: false
##   test_priority: "high_first"  # or "sequential" or "stuck_first"
##
## agent_communication:
##     -agent: "main"  # or "testing" or "user"
##     -message: "Communication message between agents"

# Protocol Guidelines for Main agent
#
# 1. Update Test Result File Before Testing:
#    - Main agent must always update the `test_result.md` file before calling the testing agent
#    - Add implementation details to the status_history
#    - Set `needs_retesting` to true for tasks that need testing
#    - Update the `test_plan` section to guide testing priorities
#    - Add a message to `agent_communication` explaining what you've done
#
# 2. Incorporate User Feedback:
#    - When a user provides feedback that something is or isn't working, add this information to the relevant task's status_history
#    - Update the working status based on user feedback
#    - If a user reports an issue with a task that was marked as working, increment the stuck_count
#    - Whenever user reports issue in the app, if we have testing agent and task_result.md file so find the appropriate task for that and append in status_history of that task to contain the user concern and problem as well 
#
# 3. Track Stuck Tasks:
#    - Monitor which tasks have high stuck_count values or where you are fixing same issue again and again, analyze that when you read task_result.md
#    - For persistent issues, use websearch tool to find solutions
#    - Pay special attention to tasks in the stuck_tasks list
#    - When you fix an issue with a stuck task, don't reset the stuck_count until the testing agent confirms it's working
#
# 4. Provide Context to Testing Agent:
#    - When calling the testing agent, provide clear instructions about:
#      - Which tasks need testing (reference the test_plan)
#      - Any authentication details or configuration needed
#      - Specific test scenarios to focus on
#      - Any known issues or edge cases to verify
#
# 5. Call the testing agent with specific instructions referring to test_result.md
#
# IMPORTANT: Main agent must ALWAYS update test_result.md BEFORE calling the testing agent, as it relies on this file to understand what to test next.

#====================================================================================================
# END - Testing Protocol - DO NOT EDIT OR REMOVE THIS SECTION
#====================================================================================================

# Testing Data - Main Agent and testing sub agent both should log testing data below this section
#====================================================================================================

CRITICAL FINDING: ❌❌❌ NESTED BUTTON HYDRATION ERROR BLOCKING ALL TESTING - React hydration error detected in StrategyTemplatesPage.jsx causing authentication and API requests to abort. TEST RESULTS: 1/2 PASS (50% success rate). ✅ PASS: (1) Admin login page loads. ❌ FAIL: (2) Navigation to /user/strategies failed - page redirects to USER login instead of loading strategies page. ROOT CAUSE ANALYSIS - NESTED BUTTON HYDRATION ERROR: Console logs reveal CRITICAL React error: 'error: <%s> cannot contain a nested %s. See this log for the ancestor stack trace. button <button>'. This error occurs in StrategyTemplatesPage.jsx lines 217-227 where the template list item container (data-testid='strategy-template-list-item-${idx}') is being rendered as a BUTTON element that contains nested BUTTON components ('Select' and 'Open detail' buttons). This is INVALID HTML and causes React hydration to fail, which then cascades into authentication and API request failures. EVIDENCE: (1) Console logs show: 'error: <%s> cannot contain a nested %s. button <button>' at StrategyTemplatesPage.jsx line 217. (2) Console logs show: 'REQUEST FAILED: http://127.0.0.1:8001/api/auth/login/admin - net::ERR_ABORTED' - login request aborted due to hydration error. (3) Console logs show: 'REQUEST FAILED: http://127.0.0.1:8001/api/strategy-templates - net::ERR_ABORTED' - API requests aborted due to hydration error. (4) Backend logs show: 'POST /api/auth/login/admin HTTP/1.1 200 OK' - backend is working correctly, issue is frontend hydration. (5) curl test confirms: Admin login API returns valid JWT token with role: super_admin. (6) Screenshots show: USER login page ('Giriş Yap') instead of admin dashboard or strategies page, confirming authentication flow is broken due to hydration error. CODE ISSUE LOCATION: StrategyTemplatesPage.jsx lines 217-227. The template list item is structured as: <div key={item.id} className={...} data-testid={`strategy-template-list-item-${idx}`}> (this is being rendered as a button) containing <Button>Select</Button> and <Button>Open detail</Button> (nested buttons). This creates invalid HTML: <button><button>Select</button><button>Open detail</button></button>. React detects this during hydration and throws error, causing the entire page to fail rendering and authentication to break. CLASSIFICATION: **REMAINING CODE ISSUE** - This is a FRONTEND CODE BUG, not an authentication or environment issue. The nested button structure in StrategyTemplatesPage.jsx is causing React hydration to fail, which cascades into authentication and API failures. Backend is working correctly (200 OK responses confirmed via curl). IMPACT: ❌❌❌ ZERO ACCEPTANCE CRITERIA CAN BE TESTED - Cannot verify any Strategy Template functionality due to nested button hydration error blocking page load. All 8 acceptance criteria blocked: (1) Login as admin - PARTIAL (page loads but auth fails due to hydration error), (2) Open /user/strategies - FAIL (redirects to user login due to hydration error), (3-8) All blocked by hydration error preventing page load. RECOMMENDATION FOR MAIN AGENT: (1) ⚠️⚠️⚠️ URGENT: Fix nested button hydration error in StrategyTemplatesPage.jsx lines 217-227. The template list item container should NOT be a button element if it contains nested Button components. (2) Change the structure to use a DIV container with separate action buttons, OR use a single clickable container with event delegation, OR restructure to avoid nesting interactive elements. (3) Example fix: Change line 217 from <button className={...} data-testid={...}> to <div className={...} data-testid={...}> to make it a non-interactive container. (4) After fixing nested button issue, retest complete Strategy Template P1 acceptance flow. (5) Verify no other pages have similar nested button/interactive element issues. This is the EXACT issue the user mentioned: 'template-list nested-button hydration fix'. The fix is straightforward: change the template list item container from a button to a div element. Once this hydration error is fixed, the complete acceptance testing can proceed. Backend is fully functional. This is a frontend-only code issue."
